第一卷 第15章 初入秘境偶遇灵药（第1页）
踏入秘境的一瞬间，外界所有喧嚣彻底隔绝。
苏玄尘深深吸了一口气，心神舒展。
极品天灵根自动运转，周身灵气飞速汇聚入体。
仅仅驻足片刻，体内灵力便隐隐增长一丝。
此刻空空荡荡，先前涌入的弟子早已四散奔逃。
所有人都在第一时间冲入密林深处，搜寻灵药灵材。
心急吃不了热豆腐，秘境凶险未知，贸然深入最易出事。
他缓步前行，目光细致扫过路边草木。
别人只顾狂奔寻宝，忽略脚下细碎机缘。
而他目光入微，百年沉稳心性让他从不放过细节。
前行百余步，一缕独特清香钻入鼻尖。
苏玄尘脚步一顿，目光锁定路边幽谷草丛之中。
几株通体翠绿、叶片带细纹的小草，静静生长。
低级灵药，价值不高，却最适合炼气低层修士。
服食可辅助凝气、稳固境界、温润经脉。
寻常外门弟子，根本看不上这种低级小草。
但对现在的苏玄尘而言，积少成多，皆是资源。
他上前，小心翼翼将几株凝气草完整采摘。
短短半柱香时间，接连收获数种低级灵药。
都是外门弟子瞧不上的零碎小东西。
可在他眼中，皆是补身养脉、辅助修行的宝物。
前方密林之中，传来几道急促脚步声，夹杂着冷笑呵斥。
“这片药田是我们先发现的，滚开！”
“区区炼气二层，也敢跟我们抢资源？找死！”
苏玄尘眉峰微挑，缓步靠近林间树丛，隐匿身形。
前方一处小型山谷，生着一片成片的月华草。
价值远超凝气草，是实打实的炼气期常用灵药。
此刻，四名身穿青衫的外门弟子，手持法器，围成一圈。
仗着人多势众，正在驱赶两名单独寻宝的弟子。
被驱赶的两人修为低微，只有炼气二层、三层。
面对四名炼气四层、五层的弟子，根本无力抗衡。
“资源秘境，有德者居之，你们太霸道了！”
为首黑衣弟子嗤笑一声，眼神凶狠。
“没实力，就别出来寻宝，滚远点！”
话音落下，他直接抬手一道微弱灵力打出。
两名弱势弟子被动震退，嘴角溢血，只能含恨离去。
四人得意大笑，转身准备采摘整片月华草。

Volume 1 Chapter 15 Entering the secret realm for the first time and encountering the elixir (Page 1)
The moment you step into the secret realm, all the hustle and bustle of the outside world is completely cut off.
Su Xuanchen took a deep breath and relaxed.
The top-grade Tianling roots operate automatically, and the spiritual energy all over the body quickly gathers into the body.
After just stopping for a moment, the spiritual power within his body grew faintly.
It was now empty, and the disciples who had previously poured in had already fled in all directions.
Everyone immediately rushed into the depths of the forest to search for elixirs and materials.
You can't eat hot tofu in a hurry. The secret place is dangerous and unknown. Going deep into it rashly is the most likely to cause trouble.
He walked forward slowly, his eyes carefully scanning the vegetation on the roadside.
Others only rush to hunt for treasures and ignore the small opportunities at their feet.
And he has a meticulous eye, and his century-old calmness makes him never let go of details.
After walking for more than a hundred steps, a wisp of unique fragrance penetrated the tip of my nose.
Su Xuanchen paused and fixed his gaze on the grass in the valley beside the road.
Several green grasses with fine stripes on their leaves are growing quietly.
Low-level elixirs are not of high value, but they are most suitable for low-level Qi refining monks.
Taking it can help condense Qi, stabilize the state, and warm and moisten the meridians.
Ordinary outer disciples would not look down on such low-level weeds at all.
But for Su Xuanchen now, little things add up to a lot, and they are all resources.
He stepped forward and carefully picked several Qi Ningcao plants completely.
In just half a stick of incense, several low-level elixirs were harvested one after another.
They are all trivial things that the outer disciples look down upon.
But in his eyes, they are all treasures that can nourish the body and nourish the pulse, and assist in spiritual practice.
In the dense forest ahead, there were several rapid footsteps, mixed with sneers and scoldings.
"We discovered this medicine field first, get out of here!"
"You're only on the second level of Qi Refining, but you dare to compete with us for resources? You're looking for death!"
Su Xuanchen raised his eyebrows slightly and slowly approached the trees in the forest, hiding his figure.
In a small valley ahead, there are patches of moonflower grass.
The value far exceeds that of Qi Condensing Grass, and it is a practical elixir commonly used during the Qi refining period.
At this moment, four outer disciples wearing green shirts, holding magic weapons, formed a circle.
Relying on the strength of the crowd, two disciples who were hunting for treasure alone were being driven away.
The two people who were driven away were of low cultivation, only at the second or third level of Qi Refining.
Facing four disciples on the fourth and fifth levels of Qi Refining, they were unable to compete.
"The secret realm of resources is where the virtuous live. You are too overbearing!"
The leading disciple in black sneered, his eyes fierce.
"If you don't have the strength, don't go out to hunt for treasures. Get away!"
After the words fell, he directly raised his hand and fired out a weak spiritual power.
The two weak disciples were forced to retreat, with blood bleeding from the corners of their mouths, and they could only leave with hatred.
The four of them laughed proudly and turned around to pick the entire patch of moonflower grass.
